[コンテンツに移動](#main) [ナビゲーションに移動](#vk-mobile-nav) Japan Porcelain Clay Shop [Arita Porcelain Clay](https://porcelain.work/) ## About us ## From Fuchino Our company is located in Arita Town, Saga Prefecture, Japan, the birthplace of Japanese porcelain, and we deliver porcelain clay to the ceramic production areas of Japan. We are still working on the development of innovative technology as a manufacturer of materials, while preserving traditional manufacturing methods. Through our website, we hope that you can learn more about our products, our staff, and our company, Fuchino Ceramics Raw Materials.
